hook: Your desert here fills with blue lagoons every year.
title: Your Desert Fills With Blue Lagoons
description:
Lençóis Maranhenses in northern Brazil looks like a desert of white dunes. After the rains, freshwater lagoons fill the gaps between them. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you swim here? Yes or no
